title: Shop Plugin By Itz
description: A Shop Plugin That Has All Of The Items That Are In Game
body:
**_Important You Need Vault And EssentialsX or Plugin Will Not Work_**
A minecraft shop plugin that has all of the items in game in categoiries.
Features:

```
/shop opens a GUI where are categories that lead to purchasable items
/buy just type in the item that you want to buy and type in the number[max 64]
/sellgui opens a gui where if you put items it will sell them acording to the sell prices in the config
/sgui short for /sellugi
```

Comands
```
/shop
/buy <item> <amount>
/sgui
/sellgui
```
Comands Examples

```
/shop
/buy totem_of_undying 5
/sgui
/sellgui
```
